blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
There are three big kinds of taxes most countries use. Income tax is paid on what a person earns from work. Corporate tax is paid on a company's profit. Sales tax, or VAT in many countries, is added to the price of things when you buy them.

Each one works differently. Income tax is calculated from your salary. Corporate tax is calculated from business profit. Sales tax sits inside the shop price — you pay it without really noticing.

Three taxes, three questions: what did you earn, what did the company profit, and what did you buy?

items.q: What is income tax paid on?
options: What a person earns from work
items.why: "Income tax is paid on what a person earns from work."

items.q: Where does sales tax "sit"?
items.why: "Sales tax sits inside the shop price."

items.q: Corporate tax is calculated from…
items.why: "Corporate tax is calculated from business profit."

items.q: The text says you pay sales tax "without really noticing." This suggests that…
options: many people do not see the tax when they buy things
shops do not pay any tax
sales tax is bigger than income tax
items.why: Inferência: o imposto já está dentro do preço, então o cliente paga sem perceber.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: different taxes are paid on different things
taxes are never added to prices
all three taxes are exactly the same
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo mostra que cada imposto incide sobre uma coisa diferente.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry explicando ao novo estagiário onde cada imposto entra. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. Let me show you the three main taxes. It is easy, I promise.

First, income tax. Look at your salary. When you earn money from work, you pay income tax on it. So the question is simple: what did you earn?

Second, corporate tax. This one is for the company, not for you. The company sells its products, it makes a profit, and it pays corporate tax on that profit. The question here is: what did the company profit?

Third, sales tax. In many countries we call it VAT. When you buy something in a shop, the tax is already inside the price. You pay it, but you often do not notice it. The question is: what did you buy?

So remember three little questions. What did you earn? What did the company profit? And what did you buy? Three questions, three taxes. That is all you need for today.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many main taxes does Harry explain?
items.why: "Let me show you the three main taxes."

items.q: According to Harry, who pays corporate tax?
items.why: "This one is for the company, not for you."

items.q: What does Harry say about sales tax in a shop?
options: It is already inside the price
You pay it later at the bank
It is added to your salary
items.why: "the tax is already inside the price."

items.q: Harry says "It is easy, I promise." This suggests that he…
options: is in a hurry to leave
wants the intern to feel calm about the topic
items.why: Inferência: ele quer tranquilizar o estagiário, mostrando que o assunto é simples.

items.q: Why does Harry repeat the three questions at the end?
options: Because the intern was not listening
To help the intern remember the three taxes
items.why: Inferência: repetir as três perguntas é uma forma de ajudar na memorização.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "She pays income tax every month." Income tax is a tax on…
items.why: Income tax = imposto de renda, pago sobre o que a pessoa ganha.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The company made a big ___ this year, so it pays more corporate tax."
items.why: Profit = lucro; o imposto corporativo incide sobre o lucro.

items.q: "He gets his salary on the first day of the month." A salary is…
options: the money you get from work
items.why: Salary = salário, o dinheiro que se recebe pelo trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ of the coffee is ten dollars, and the sales tax is already inside it."
items.why: Price = preço; o imposto sobre vendas já está dentro do preço.

items.q: "You pay VAT but you often do not notice it." To notice means to…
options: see or become aware of something
items.why: To notice = perceber, dar-se conta de algo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em conversas de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the tax report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new tax rules next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar, começar a usar algo novo.

items.q: "I need to fill out the tax form." To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher um formulário.

items.q: "Let me break it down for the new intern." To break it down means to…
items.why: Break it down = explicar em partes simples.

items.q: "Please keep track of your work expenses." To keep track of means to…
items.why: Keep track of = acompanhar, controlar e registrar algo.
